schema_notes.fill_price_convention: THE FILL IS THE BROKER'S 'Net Prc' COLUMN, NEVER amount/shares. Settled 2026-08-26 after the two disagreed on every recent paste. amount/shares is the LIMIT notional; Net Prc is the executed share-weighted average, and a limit fills AT OR BETTER than its limit — which is why Net Prc is favourable in BOTH directions (FANG sell 197.72 > 197.0000; EQT buy 53.8559 < 53.9600). The decisive evidence is decimal places: EQT's 53.8559 carries FOUR, and a US equity limit cannot, because the minimum tick is $0.01 — so it can only be an average of executions, while 197.0000 and 53.9600 are exact to the cent, as limits are. NOTE ON PROVENANCE: no broker statement exists on this machine (searched Downloads/Desktop/Documents), so this was adjudicated from the arithmetic above plus minute bars, NOT read off a statement. It is a reasoned convention, not a documented one. WHY IT MATTERS: realized_r is stored RECOMPUTABLE from the stored entry_stop, so a limit-derived price stores a wrong R against a correct stop.
